scope: Horizontal, single-line flex rows containing fixed descendants; horizontal-tb, no direct text/contents items, sticky descendants or auto side margins. Existing fixed containing blocks and absolute descendants anchored to the scroller are preserved.
rootCause: Artificial transforms on ordinary flex item wrappers establish new fixed/absolute containing blocks. Nested positioned elements are then re-anchored instead of preserving the source scroll viewport.
implementation: Translate each in-flow flex item with opposite physical side-margin changes so its outer main-axis size is unchanged. This introduces no containing block. Shift positioned descendant insets only when their source offsetParent is the original scroller; existing wrapper/ancestor/viewport anchors remain unchanged.

baseline.positiveControl: Existing transformed wrapper already has the correct fixed containing block and passes in all three engines.
